shellCommands.command: git diff && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v package-lock && cat package.json next.config.* 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/package.json && node -p "require('next/package.json').version"
for f in app/*.tsx app/*/page.tsx tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; echo; head -50 __agent_eval__/run.mjs

ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "cacheComponents" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -20; grep -n "hours" -A6 node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js | head -30

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; cat 03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md; ls 02-guides | grep -i -E "cache|migrat"; grep -rn -i "force-dynamic\|revalidate = \|route segment config" 02-guides/*cache* 2>/dev/null | head -30

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -H 'Cookie: draft-title=Budget%20vote%20recap' localhost:3123/preview | grep -o 'Budget[^<]*'; curl -s localhost:3123/preview | grep -o '<p[^>]*>Untitled draft'; curl -sI localhost:3123/news | grep -i cache-control; pkill -f "next start"; git status --short
